scope: HD Manager / existing employee salary policy / monthly Development

authorization.tenant: authenticated companyId must match the target employee
authorization.approval: active status requires the existing salary-policy permission; actual actor/date are retained in the salary-policy history
authorization.concurrency: existing salaryPolicyVersion is checked inside the Firestore transaction before merge

methods.above_kpi: MAX(0, eligible revenue - target) × fixed rate
methods.progressive: sum of the disjoint occupied tier amounts × their rates
methods.retrospective: the rate of the occupied attained tier applies to all excess revenue

tierContract.bounds: (from, to], first from=0, final to=null, contiguous and nonoverlapping
tierContract.fixedBonus: once per occupied enabled tier; retrospective uses only the attained tier
tierContract.disabled: no commission or fixed bonus for this range
tierContract.rounding: sum exact integer rate units, round final total to 2 decimals; expose any row-display rounding adjustment
tierContract.deletion: a tier referenced by prior active policy history cannot be removed from the same policy identity; a new policy version can use new tier IDs

dates.quarterAndYear: deferred by Owner until monthly payroll allocation rules are supplied

recognized_net.discount: already deducted by OrderManagementView; do not deduct twice
recognized_net.excluded: archived, canceled, reversed, draft or unconfirmed orders

collected.time: payment date in the selected month
collected.excluded: opening debt, unallocated overpayment, duplicate/reversed/unofficial receipts
collected.incomplete: untraceable prepayment credits or missing matched source orders block reconciliation

revenue.returns: BUSINESS_RULE_REQUIRED or unconfirmed return financial evidence blocks payroll closing; Owner deferred the return valuation rule to a separate task

migration.legacyFields: commissionRate, targetRevenue and commissionTiers are preserved
migration.default: no automatic activation or application of the HD sample
migration.draft: stored separately; does not replace the live policy
migration.activation: explicit salary-authorized save adds a dated history version

rollback.effect: adds a new dated version with commissionPolicy=null and retains legacy inputs and all old history
rollback.execution: apply via the existing optimistic employee transaction after authorized review
